# HireAIVoice by HonorElevate

HireAIVoice is Connor MacIvor's entry service for AI phone support. HonorElevate is the platform and managed-service expansion path. Based in Santa Clarita; serves suitable businesses in Los Angeles County and elsewhere.

## Contact
AI voice demo: (661) 219-7299. Connor's AI business line: (661) 476-2217.

## Scope
Start with agreed after-hours or overflow coverage, approved business information, request capture, and a defined human handoff. Carrier forwarding must be verified. An appointment request is not a confirmed booking. Direct booking requires a supported connected calendar and acceptance testing. AI can make mistakes. This is not an emergency service or professional advice service.

AI identification is a product standard. Audio recording, transcription, AI processing, summaries, consent, and retention require separate configuration and review. Disabling audio recording does not establish that no personal data is processed.

## Commercial terms
Published plans: Starter $397/month; Full System $597/month. Published trial: 30 days free. Neither plan has a setup fee. Custom expansion is scoped separately. Availability, actual scope, usage, overages, support, renewal, cancellation, and data handling must be confirmed in writing before activation. Existing accepted customer agreements govern existing service. Turning off forwarding does not itself cancel billing.

Platform access is different from implementation. Larger builds, migrations, campaigns, content production, and custom integrations need separate scope and pricing. No revenue result or unlimited labor is promised.
